TURING MACHINE: 1X W/VIZ

PARAM SETS CHANCE THAT A NEW
VALUE GETS CREATED PER TICK.

CV OUT: FIRST 8 BITS.
GATE OUT: FIRST BIT.



#1
X <<< X 1; J TOSS
PROB PRM: X BCLR X 0; X + X J
Y & X 255
Z SCL 0 255 0 V 10 Y
CV 1 Z
IF BGET X 0: TR.PULSE 1

#2
L 0 15: G.LED I 0 * 7 BGET X I
L 0 15: G.LED I 1 * 7 BGET Y I

#3

#4

#5

#6

#7

#8

#M
$ 1
$ 2

#I
PARAM.SCALE 0 100
X 0
G.CLR

#P
